database_limit: Commander Spellbook is incomplete, especially for new cards. No-match records are evidence, not proof of absence.
notes: Six changed exact main lists were rescanned and manually reviewed on 2026-09-05. The four unchanged mains and Gandalf’s nine-card configuration switch retain hash-matching reviewed evidence with their original dates. Database omissions and manual screening do not prove combo completeness.

decks.summary: The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan returned no included combo. Balmor adds finite instant/sorcery combat scaling, Tocasia's Welcome triggers only once each turn, and Cosmic Rebirth is a one-shot recursion spell. Jeskai Ascendancy and mana creatures still lack a repeatable spell or bounce engine; the nearby buyback, Freed from the Real, and Intruder Alarm templates have missing named cards.

The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan returned no included combo. Devoted Druid has left the deck. Bala Ged Recovery and Bridgeworks Battle add two spell/land MDFCs, while Hammer of Nazahn and Krosan Grip add protection and interaction. Selvala, Bear Umbra, Pip-Boy 3000, Shifting Woodland, and the Equipment-copy package still lack a repeatable untap or extra-combat loop; the Hammer/Apex Altisaur candidate lacks Apex Altisaur.

The refreshed exact-list scan returned no included combo. Hobbit Hole replaces Terramorphic Expanse without adding a repeatable Food, life-gain, sacrifice, or historic-card recursion loop; The One Ring and the Food/Hobbit engines remain finite.

The posted Maximum Flavor main deck returned no included combo and contains neither Surge to Victory nor Savage Beating. Its exact nine-for-nine Maximum Power switch adds both cards plus Solve the Equation, restoring the deck's intentional conditional unlimited-combat finish only in the Maximum Power configuration.

lines.reason: The line is absent from the posted Maximum Flavor main deck. In the exact Maximum Power configuration, cast Surge to Victory with Savage Beating in the graveyard; each successful combat-damage trigger can cast another untap-and-additional-combat copy.

decks.summary: Commander Spellbook returned the Mikaeus and Viscera Seer template, but the refreshed exact list still has no qualifying persist creature. Metamorphosis Fanatic and Tortured Existence improve recursion, while Kardur adds finite combat control; manual review found no replacement prerequisite or new deterministic loop.

decks.summary: The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan returned no included combo. Abjure and Flare of Denial provide one-shot sacrifice costs; Flare requires a nontoken blue creature and cannot sacrifice an Illusion token. Flow of Knowledge and the two Thirst spells improve finite instant-speed draw/discard. Manual review of Minn, Illusion copies, the Altars, Blasting Station, and draw engines found no unrestricted return-and-sacrifice cycle. The nearby Meloku, Fool's Demise, persist/undying, and Lyla templates remain incomplete. Teferi, Master of Time can take two consecutive extra turns via its ultimate, which remains a separate pregame disclosure.

All three returned Apex Altisaur and Wrathful Raptors lines are present. They clear opposing creatures and can deal near-infinite damage when opposing bodies keep Apex Altisaur's fight chain going; Savage Order is the compact tutored version and is the list's main Bracket 3 disclosure.

The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan again returned the finite Fire Covenant and Brash Taunter kill. Fighter Class improves Sunforger access, while Galadriel's Dismissal, Tibalt's Trickery, Nils, and Combat Calligrapher add finite interaction or combat incentives. The five-card Arcbond loop remains present: copy Arcbond onto Brash Taunter and Selfless Squire, resolve the Squire's enter trigger that turn, make both indestructible, then have Brash fight the Squire. No new complete loop was identified among the changed cards.

lines.reason: Resolve Selfless Squire's enter trigger this turn to prevent damage to you. Copy Arcbond so Brash Taunter and the Squire each have its delayed trigger, give both indestructible with Boros Charm, and activate Brash Taunter to fight the Squire while it can tap. Each Arcbond trigger damages the other creature and creates the next trigger; the prevention effect protects you while opponents take each iteration.

decks.summary: The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan returned no included combo. Sylvan Library and Tamiyo's Safekeeping replace Strionic Resonator and The Shire, adding selection and protection without a repeatable untap or creature-recast engine. The Notary's two token copies, Parallel Lives, Panharmonicon, Maskwood Nexus, and haste still generate large finite mana bursts. Nearby Staff of Domination, Umbral Mantle, Sword of the Paruns, Food Chain, and Temur Sabertooth lines have missing named pieces.

The 2026-09-05 exact-list scan returned no included combo. Molten Echoes has left the deck. Chronicle of Victory adds cast-based draw and combat pressure; Priest of Ancient Lore adds a Dwarf enter trigger; Ascend from Avernus and Sevinne's Reclamation add finite recovery and exile after their relevant graveyard use. Thorin, Bifur, Panharmonicon, Anointed Procession, Cadric, and Fíli still multiply triggers, tokens, and Treasures finitely. The closest Reaver Cleaver, Magda, and Thorin, Company's Leader loops lack Aggravated Assault, Hellkite Charger, or a repeatable untap engine.
